title: run.v1
description: The record of one crawl run (runs/<run_id>.json, rewritten atomically). The requests themselves live in crawlee's persisted request queue named `queue` (dedup by unique_key), so `li crawl resume` reopens it and never re-GETs a handled request.

command.description: ab runs are experiments and panel runs are scheduled revisits: neither is ever resumed (the next scheduled run replaces a stopped panel run); probe runs are one robots.txt GET and are never resumed either.

source.description: The source (site) whose pages this run fetches.

queue.description: crawlee RequestQueue name under the STATE root ($<state_env>)/crawlee.

approval_ref.description: The operator approval this run consumed (ADR-0006).

standing.description: Consumed one run of a standing (scheduled, pre-signed) approval.

run.description: Which run of the standing approval this was (1-based).

refunded.description: The run was refused before any site request and its approval was refunded (approvals.refund): it no longer counts as a use.

bounded.description: Consumed by one step of a `<cli> refresh` chain under its bounded approval.

list_pages.description: bounded: the most list pages this step may send (counted against the bounds).

ad_requests.description: bounded: the ad requests this step sends (counted against the bounds).

list_set.description: bounded crawl-lists: the index of the signed list set this step crawled.

log_ref.description: The run's live JSON-lines log, relative to the data dir (ADR-0007).

sample.description: fetch-ads --sample: the design of this run's depth-stratified ad sample (H4).

select.description: recruit: a one-off sample of ads seen on list cards but never opened (fetch-ads --select recruit).

card.description: The run card printed at the start of the run (ADR-0011).

roots.description: Each root named on the card, as an absolute path (shown once).

proxy.description: The run's ONE proxy (never credentials): chosen at --plan, signed in the plan, kept on resume.

supersedes.description: The stopped run whose pending requests this run took over (fetch-ads --supersede, or a crawl resume of a fetch-ads run), each admitted through the fresh-sighting gate again; that run gets a `superseded` event naming this one.

supersede_scope.description: What this run took over from the run it supersedes: its pending ad requests, or (fetch-ads --supersede --failed) its failed ones. Each scope is taken over once. Absent on runs before the field: those took the pending ones.

probe.description: probe robots: the ONE GET's outcome. Markers describe the body; the body itself is never stored here.

status.description: HTTP status; null when no response came

reason.description: null when clean; a challenge.detect() code, http_<status>, unexpected_page, or the error type

stop.description: Why the run stopped with a non-zero exit: the exit code (e.g. 14 parse/yield) and its reason. run.v1 has no exit field otherwise; absent on runs that ended cleanly and on runs before the field.

list.description: crawl-lists: what the list walk yielded. Only a `status` of ok, end, ceiling_hit or anchored is a good crawl (liveness.Rules, ADR-0017 B.2);the stop values (zero_yield, failed, blocked, parse_drift, end_unknown, short_census) are terminal. Absent on runs before the field.

status.description: ok: pages parsed with cards; zero_yield: page 1 gave 0 cards with no positive END; failed: a handler error; blocked: a challenge or refusal stopped it; parse_drift: too many cards skipped by the parser; past_end / redirected (an evidence run, --snapshot only): the run completed, but a list page answered 404/410 without the end marker, or ended at another URL, so its sightings are not trusted; end: the list positively ENDED (end_read_page; end_page in a walk); end_unknown: a page after page 1 gave 0 cards with no positive END, or carried the end marker on a page that is not an END, or a walk drained with neither an END nor its ceiling (exit 14); short_census (a walk): the list ENDED before min_pages (exit 14); ceiling_hit (a walk): the walk read its signed ceiling of pages before any END; anchored (a frontier): it stopped at a confirmed anchor (list.anchor). Good crawls: ok, end, ceiling_hit, anchored (liveness.Rules). clamped is reserved (a clamp is an END, end_method clamped).

end_page.description: The LAST page of the list (its page count), exact: the page before end_read_page. Set where it is exact: in a walk (pages read contiguously from page 1), or when page 1 itself ENDED (0, an empty subcategory).

end_read_page.description: The lowest page whose read ENDED the list: it carried the source's end marker with 0 parsed cards at the URL asked for, or (a walk's clamp) repeated earlier pages' ids.

end_method.description: How the END was found: end_marker (the source's end_selectors), or clamped (a walk: more than half of a page's ids already seen earlier in the walk; that page's cards are not kept).

mode.description: crawl-lists --mode: walk = pages 1, 2, 3, ..., the next one enqueued only after the current one is handled (ADR-0017 A), a census; frontier = the same, and it may stop at an anchor confirmed against its reference crawl (A.2). Absent: the page-count sample or named pages.

subcategory.description: A walk's subcategory: a later frontier finds its reference by it.

region.description: A walk's region: a later frontier finds its reference by it.

k.description: A frontier's signed K: a candidate anchor is K consecutive parsed cards holding consecutive places in the reference's parsed order.

order.description: A frontier: the source's declared list order. Only bump_desc allows an early stop; any other value walks to a positive END or the ceiling.

policy_digest.description: A walk's SyncPolicy digest at its start, the rules its approval signed: a resume under another digest is refused (exit 10).

ref_crawl_id.description: A frontier's reference crawl, chosen once at its start (plan.frontier_reference; a resume keeps it); null when none existed (a bootstrap).

anchor.description: A frontier's confirmed anchor: the candidate's page and the ONE confirmation page after it (list.status anchored).

gap.description: A walk's open GAP: the walk opened_by hit its ceiling at after_page, so the bumps between it and since_ref (null: no reference before it, or a census) were never read. A frontier on a reference with an open GAP keeps that GAP's since_ref and opened_by (the smaller after_page); a later frontier anchored on it carries it on; only a census that read to its END (as the reference) closes it.

stride.description: A walk's stride (1 = census; stride k is deferred).

ceiling.description: A walk's signed ceiling: every list GET it may send (--max-pages), the END page included.

min_pages.description: A walk's signed --min-pages: an END with end_page below it is short_census.

pages_read.description: A walk's list pages handled, across every attempt (the END page included).

settled.description: A walk's list GETs sent, across every attempt (retries and GETs a challenge or a crash handed back included), counted before each GET: the ceiling counts these.

snapshot.description: crawl-lists --snapshot: where the run's list pages were saved, with a list_snapshot.v1 sidecar per page.

saved.description: Sidecars written (pages answered, a challenge page included).

redirected.description: Pages whose final URL differs from the URL asked for.

observations_written.description: Observation rows this run appended (rows are persisted before any stop).

ads.description: fetch-ads: the selection (select_ads) and its outcome. Absent on runs before the field.

lanes.description: Ads planned per lane. revisit is hard-capped at ceil(rho * budget); unused new-lane quota never flows into it.

eligible.description: Ads that passed the fresh-sighting gate, before the budget.

excluded.description: Ads left out of the plan, by liveness state. Nothing is ever deleted: dormant ads (only sighted long ago) get 0 GETs.

ad_gets.description: Ad page GETs this run sent.

ok.description: Of ad_gets, those that wrote a listing.

gone.description: Of ad_gets, those that wrote a gone event.

parse_streak.description: Ad pages of this site that failed to parse since its last fetch-ads run that parsed one, this run included (breaker.parse_streak). At breaker_floor, a run that parsed nothing ends exit 14.

as_of.description: The plan time the selection was made at (signed in a standalone plan; inside a refresh, the latest sighting of its passed list steps). fetch_reason and the freshness window read it, never the wall clock.

policy_digest.description: sha256 of the SyncPolicy the selection ran under (policy.py), signed in the plan or the refresh bounds.

breaker.description: fetch-ads: the gone-storm / ad-failure breaker. A trip stops the run (exit 14) and opens a gone_storm incident. Absent on runs before the field.

kind.description: gone: gones that rest on absence or a redirect (never expired_notice or http_410); failure: parse_failed.

g.description: Counted events when it was evaluated.

n.description: Ad GETs when it was evaluated.

egress.description: Where this machine's traffic left from, per Cloudflare's trace endpoint, checked before the run. The public IP is deliberately not recorded.

requests.description: Requests this run sent, counted at the backend layer (every attempt, retries included). list_pages/ad_pages are page GETs (navigations), robots and other go through the HTTP client; with a browser backend, site_subresources/third_party/redirects count what each page load sent besides its GET. egress_trace goes to the egress-check endpoint, never the site. failed_before_request counts attempts that errored before sending anything.

site_subresources.description: Browser requests to the site's host or its subdomains other than the page GET (CSS, JS, images, XHR; disk-cache hits included).

third_party.description: Browser requests to any other host (incl. iframes).

redirects.description: Main-frame redirect hops after a page GET.

failed_before_request.description: Attempts that errored before any GET (e.g. the browser failed to launch): zero requests.

site_subresources_blocked.description: Of site_subresources, those the browser blocked ([crawl] block_extensions): attempted, never sent. Sent = site_subresources - site_subresources_blocked (crawl.sent).

third_party_blocked.description: Of third_party, those the browser blocked (tracker lists, or a block_extensions match): attempted, never sent.

site_subresources_answered.description: Of site_subresources, image requests the browser answered itself with a placeholder ([crawl] image_mode answer): attempted, never sent.

third_party_answered.description: Of third_party, image requests the browser answered itself: attempted, never sent.

trackers_blocked.description: Of third_party_blocked, those EasyList/EasyPrivacy blocked (trackers.py): attempted, never sent.

lane.description: fetch-ads --sample over a pool with revisits: the lane this stratum belongs to (revisits are sampled first, capped at ceil(rho * n)). Absent when the pool had no revisit.
